scenarios.reasoning: The agent did excellent investigative work tracing the build failure through the binlog, correctly identifying the Debug/Release configuration mismatch and the mechanism (RemoveProperties). However, it missed the deeper root cause — that the project likely isn't in the solution, which is why the configuration mismatch matters. The standard MSBuild ResolveProjectReferences behavior with RemoveProperties works correctly when projects are in the solution because they've already been built. The agent's analysis is technically accurate at the mechanism level but misses the architectural root cause and the most appropriate fix (adding the project to the solution).
